main_text.l: Viro Maximo
JOANNI DALLÆO.
{Q}UID si ipsum audires Lector, sua ver-
ba tonantem,
Cum jacit æterno fulmina digna
Deo; Attonitosque trahit populos, & pectora mul-
cet,
Eloquioque potens regnat, & astra quatit?
DALLÆUM nemo, DALLÆI, dicere
posses,
Vox superat calamum, solaque Lingua manum.
Attamen hoc præsto, Genium non defore chartis,
Quæ de DALLÆI nomine nomen habent.
Maxima pars isto vel amœna effundimus ævo,
Vel gravia & nullo tincta lepore damus:
Pagina DALLÆI quovis sub judice punctum
Omne tulit, lepidum seu grave quæris opus;
Hìc lepor occurrit, qualem decet esse virorum,
Qualis & Angelico fulget in ore lepor:
Hìc gravitas lato incedit perfusa sereno,
Cœlesti gravitas convenit illa choro.
Triste supercilium procul hinc, procul omnis
& horror,
Barbariesque ipso pœnè superba situ:
Mollities tamen omnis abest, & luxus inermis
Frangens

page.notes: The initial Q is a woodcut initial, joined to the first word. Verse lines are set in italic; capitalised words in the verse are small capitals. The text reads "Frangens" as the closing word, right aligned. Some ligature and long-s forms were normalised to plain s. Letter-level ambiguities in the initial word of the line "Hìc" are rendered with the printed accent.
